title: Income Reality Engine contract
description: Request/response shapes for POST /api/v1/income-reality/breakdown. Feature 1 supplies persisted Monday-start weekly entries and Feature 2 performs deterministic calculations. Monetary values are integer cents; dates are ISO 8601 strings, per contracts/README.md.

week_start.description: ISO 8601 date. Must be a Monday under the proposed week-start convention.

work_costs_cents.description: Aggregate declared work costs for the week (fuel, tolls, commission, rental, etc.). Itemisation is owned by feature/01-foundation-input's data intake.

recorded_cpf_cents.description: Actual CPF/MediSave recorded in Feature 1. When present, it overrides the percentage estimate for this week.

apply_cpf.description: Whether to deduct the simplified flat-rate CPF/MediSave estimate for weeks without a recorded CPF amount. Not the real statutory schedule.

cpf_rate_bps.description: Flat contribution rate in basis points (800 = 8.00%), applied to gross earnings when apply_cpf is true. Editable per request.

weeks.description: Oldest week first. The engine does not read persisted entries itself - the caller supplies them directly.

net_income_cents.description: gross_earnings_cents - work_costs_cents - cpf_cents. Not floored at zero: a deficit week is reported as a true negative.

surplus_cents.description: net_income_cents - essential_expenses_cents. Not floored at zero.

stdev_net_income_cents.description: Population standard deviation of net_income_cents across the supplied weeks.

conservative_weekly_income_cents.description: max(0, round(raw_average - raw_stdev)), computed from the unrounded average/stdev and rounded once - NOT average_net_income_cents minus stdev_net_income_cents (those are independently rounded for display and can be off by a cent from this). Never negative.
